parsed.rationale: Both participating records are test/mock fixtures. `MockAudioPlayerForController` lives in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/AudioPlayerControllerTests.swift` (a test file) and `MockAudioPlayer` lives in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioPlayer.swift` (a mock utility file under the Tests tree). Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test or mock fixture warrants no-action; here both records carry that character. Consolidating these mocks could couple distinct test scenarios to a single shared stub, reducing test isolation and making individual test suites harder to evolve independently.
